title: Nanhey Dil [Hindi][CAM]
description: Set against the contrasting worlds of Mumbai's slums and elite educational institutions, Nanhey Dil follows the journey of Raghu Jadhav, the young son of a dhobi whose life takes an unexpected turn when he secures admission to a prestigious school. The opportunity comes through Principal Anthony, who believes that every child deserves access to quality education, regardless of their financial or social background. However, Raghu soon discovers that entering a new world is easier than finding his place within it. Surrounded by affluent classmates, modern facilities and an unfamiliar English-speaking environment, he struggles with self-doubt and feelings of inferiority. What begins as an intimidating experience gradually transforms into a beautiful journey of friendship when Raghu's classmates discover the warmth of his simple homemade food. An innocent exchange of lunchboxes becomes the beginning of an extraordinary bond that challenges prejudices and bridges social divides. As Raghu develops friendships with Aakash, Rohit, Anjali, Rahul, Amit and Priya, the children begin learning valuable lessons from one another. While Raghu discovers confidence and acceptance, his friends experience the joy of simplicity, family connections and unconditional love.

It’s a story of friends who can always count on each other − but, most of all, Numberblocks is about having fun with numbers.

Each episode has been carefully crafted with the help of the NCETM (National Centre for Excellence in the Teaching of Mathematics) and brought to life by Blue Zoo Animation Studio.

We work closely with the NCETM to make sure Numberblocks delivers the essential numeracy skills that build good number sense and a solid foundation for a lifetime of maths success.
‍
Get ready for an animated adventure and some number magic that you can count on to help your child learn maths in the most exciting way.

1, 2, 3 − Let’s go!

title: She and Her Perfect Husband [Hindi]
description: Single female lawyer Qin Shi is focused on her career, but was rushed into marriage by her parents. The top lawyer firm, Cheng and Hui is recruiting lawyers specializing in family affairs, and one of the requirements is to be married. Qin Wei, Qin Shi's second brother who is also a headhunter, secretly changed Qin Shi's marriage status to "married" without her permission, thus creating a fictional husband for her out of nowhere. Not knowing anything, Qin Shi was employed. Her outstanding performance earned the approval of the founder, Lao Jin. During a gathering with partners, Lao Jin recommended Qin Shi to be a legal counsel for the Association of Women Entrepreneurs. It is only then Qin Shi realizes that she is "married". Qin Shi decides to clarify the situation to Lao Jin, but at this moment her "husband" Yang Hua appears. He was forced by his mother to come for a matchmaking session with Qin Shi's competitor. Feeling angry about his mother's forceful actions, he has no choice but to seek the help of Qin Shi. Thus, the two people who are unwilling to be forced into marriage, hit it off immediately, and impulsively decide to register their marriage. However, both their parents sense something wrong with the situation. At this moment, Qin Shi's ex-boyfriend suddenly joined the law firm. Facing the numerous crisis, Qin Shi and Yang Hua begin to slowly fall for each other, and fortuitously acquire true love.

title: Reborn to Master the Blade: From Hero-King to Extraordinary Squire [Hindi]
description: From his deathbed, Hero-King Inglis, the divine knight and master of all he surveys, gazes down on the empire he built with his mighty hand. Having devoted his life to statecraft and his subjects' well-being, his one unfulfilled wish is to live again, for himself this time: a warrior's life he'd devoted himself to before his rise to power. His patron goddess, Alistia, hears his plea and smiles upon him, flinging his soul into the far future. Goddesses work in mysterious ways, so not only is Inglis now the daughter of a minor noble family, but at her first coming-of-age ceremony at 6, she's found ineligible to begin her knighthood. However, for a lady of Inglis's ambition, this is less a setback and more the challenge she was (re)born to overcome. "It's not the blood that runs through your veins that makes a knight; it's the blood you shed on the battlefield". The curtain rises on the legend of an extraordinary lady squire reborn to master the blade.

description: A young alcoholic ambient musician locks himself in his apartment on a dangerous seven day bender as he attempts to finish his upcoming album.

description: Lee Tae Poong has childlike intelligence after an accident. Han Yoo Jung abandons her dream job to support her impoverished family amid her twin's misdeeds. Their lives intertwine as they face miracles at death's door.

title: When a Man's a Man
description: Helen Wakefield refuses the marriage proposal of Lawrence Knight, a rich lounge lizard, and advises him to improve himself by developing manly traits. He travels out west, changes his name to "Patches," and gets together some cattle rustlers. He is accused of being an outlaw and of shooting a fellow cowpuncher, falls in love with a ranch girl, leaves her, and then accidentally meets Helen Wakefield in a pasture where he is trying to rope a ferocious bull and she is drawing water. As the bull attacks Helen, Knight lassos it in time to save her; and they recognize each other. During his absence Helen has married and come to the West accompanied by her surveyor husband. Knight's old love flashes up, but having recently developed manly traits, he sets his jaw and departs for another section of the country.

title: Summer Time
description: In the gloomy 80s, Sang-ho is wanted by the authorities for his participation in the student movement. Parting with his colleagues, Sang-ho happens to end up in a town on the outskirts, a town he has no connection to. The place where he is in hiding is the second floor of a worn down wooden house. Spending his time idly in the room, one day, Sang-ho discovers a hole looking into the room downstairs by chance. Casually looking through the hole, Sang-ho exhales. At first, Sang-ho tries to avoid looking, out of guilt. However, before he knows it, he is drawn to the hole. Every gesture she makes is very captivating and seductive. He watches her body, feels her, and takes her into his heart.

title: A Year in a Village
description: The documentary A Year in a Village features a village in Moravia, Czech Republic. The focus is on 12-year-old Vojta and his father Danek, who are both into beekeeping and on Vojta's 16-year-old cousin Anetka, who is preparing for her first participation in "hody" celebration, and of their grandmother Bohuska. We watch the members of the family work and perform their hobbies. We listen to their opinions, trying to understand their thinking, as well as the world they live in. Even though a part of the documentary features the traditional feast called "hody", the aim is not to describe the event itself, but to understand how the characters feel about being a part of it and how it influences them.

title: A Fist for a Fist
description: Kung-Fu Superstar Chen Hui Man (Chinese Super Ninja) is the righteous fighter with the invincible fists. Or so he thought. Chen Hui Min is in the role of a lifetime, playing a good guy in a career dominated by bad guy and gangster role. His off screen life is just as action packed as his films.

title: A Verdade Sob a Pele
description:
"Há vinte anos, a empregada da família Pinheiro confundiu acidentalmente um remédio para dormir com um suplemento nutricional e injetou-o na filha recém-nascida de Hugo Pinheiro, fazendo com que a bebê apresentasse dificuldade respiratória e estivesse à beira da morte. Assustada com as consequências, a empregada procurou uma outra bebê para substituí-la e abandonou a filha de Hugo em uma floresta remota.
Surpreendentemente, a criança sobreviveu e foi salva por Elisa Lemos, que estava lá para enterrar sua própria filha que tinha falecido. Elisa adotou a menina, deu-lhe o nome de Chloé Lemos e a criou até a vida adulta.
Vinte anos depois, Chloé Lemos entra para trabalhar no Grupo Pinheiro. No entanto, por causa da sua condição financeira modesta, ela passa a ser alvo de perseguições da filha da empregada, Laura Pinheiro. Laura inculpa Chloé de roubo, a humilha e a tortura de várias maneiras."

title: Plan B
description: Et si c'était possible de faire marche arrière dans le temps pour modifier le cours des événements et changer sa destinée? Et si une deuxième chance nous était offerte? Et si c'était possible grâce à Plan B - Le jour où Philippe perd l'amour de sa vie, Evelyne, il découvre une invraisemblable compagnie du nom de Plan B qui offre la possibilité de revenir dans le passé. Après un premier essai fructueux, Philippe réalise l'immense pouvoir que lui donne ce stratagème. Il voudra donc aussi s'en servir au profit de son cabinet d'avocats qu'il possède avec son associé/ami/beau-frère Patrice et pour remettre son frère André sur le droit chemin. Mais Philippe réalisera qu'un choix nouveau, aussi minime soit-il, a des répercussions aussi incontrôlables qu'insoupçonnées sur sa vie et celle des autres. Plus rien ne sera sans conséquence. Le jeu en vaut-il la chandelle? Valait-il mieux accepter son véritable destin?

title: Ivelisse vs Izzy B
description: Kelsey Raegan wears the stripes and you can tell from the introductions that she may not be impartial here. Ivelisse eats youngsters like Izzy for snacks, but Izzy challenges her to a most knockouts within the time limit rules match. Ivelisse comes out blasting with roundhouse kicks, turnbuckle smashes and face slams. She mounts Izzy for a straitjacket choke that quickly secures the first knockout. Izzy took her lumps but learned her lessons and after a back and forth fight she uses the same hold to kayo the veteran! Ivelisse is livid, but Kelsey is thrilled and the battle continues. Ivelisse takes the fight to Izzy, putting her out with a choking facelock and back mounted Camel Clutch, but each time Izzy manages to mimic her opponent’s offense and knocks Ivelisse out using her own holds. Tied in falls and with time ticking down, the pair brawl for control. Ivelisse nails the lanky blonde with kicks, stomps and chokes before driving her face first into the turnbuckles. Can Ivelisse put the youngster down once more to secure the win, or will Izzy prove herself against the veteran…and will Kelsey stay out of the fight?

title: The White Olive Tree
description: In turbulent Dongguo, reporter Song Ran meets demolition engineer Li Zan. Their shared ideals spark romance, cut short by an explosion. Back home, they face guilt until reuniting to plant olive seeds, symbolizing recovery.

title: Sky C.
description: Sofia (AKA Sky) is a single mom supporting her daughter and her father. Growing up in the gym watching her father train to become a professional boxer her passion has always been to become a MMA pro-fighter. Her father's dream was cut short in the fight that would make him a professional boxer, when he sustained a spinal injury confining him to a wheelchair. Now her father is adamantly against Sky having any part of fighting for fear of her succumbing to the same fate he endures. But Sky passion for fighting could not be extinguished, so she continued to train in between working, being a mother and caretaker. After losing her main source of income, financial struggles ensue that forces her to secretly take underground fights to make money to support her family. One night she knocks out an opponent and it turns out to be the current MMA champion. The crowd has it all on video and the footage goes viral causing the MMA champion to challenge her to a real match that proves that Sky's knockout was just lucky. The viral footage gets back to her father and he further finds that his best friend was part of her training. The father confronts them both and the argument reveals the truth of why he didn't want Sky to fight. Sky leaves with her daughter and begins training for the fight of her life, without her father, until the day of the fight.

title: The Last Oath
description: In a zombie apocalypse, an immune survivor falls for the agent sent to hunt him as rival powers close in around them.

title: Plan C-14 II
description:
Martin, an 83-year-old industrious man, will embark on a unique journey at 14.000 ft through the deserted highlands of the Argentine Andes mountains.

Plan C-14 II blends an air of melancholy and beauty as we admire the life of Martin Pueyrredon. He's 83 years old and has recently lost his wife of 60 years, followed by his best friend and traveling partner, with whom his outdoor adventures had taken on profound meaning. Their deaths leave him empty, even as he declares himself a "happy old man." He continues to work his engineering job, lays flowers on his wife's grave, and trains for another long adventure-this time, solo. It is important to have plans, he says. He is running out of time and against all odds and Doctor's recommendations, he is determined to have one last adventure before the end. His love and dedication for traveling are stronger than any medical diagnosis. Amid the windswept plains, canyons, dirt roads and high mountain passes of the Argentinean Andes, Pueyrredon repeats the final journey he made with his departed friend, bicycling alone for five days to a viaduct at 14,000 feet, guided by his memory. The film's most moving scene will challenge the dry eyes of even the sternest stoic. "I don't feel they are gone," Pueyrredon says of his wife and friend.

"What we realize through this film is that our most profound journeys can happen at any time in life - and perhaps the later we take them, the more rich and meaningful they become. And, no matter the challenges we face in life, there is always joy to be found - even in the most fleeting moments."


* Rebecca Martin, jury member

title: The Blossoming Love
description: Ancient Emperor Zhao Ming and lover Hun Dun Zhu reincarnate as rivals Xie Xue Chen and Mu Xuan Ling. While seeking divine artifact, enemies become allies and fall in love. After her sacrifice, he time travels to save her.

title: My Fake Husband Is the Dragon King
description: Three years ago, Elena was drugged by her sister Helena and had a wild night with Dragon King Derek, later laying two dragon eggs. Helena stole the eggs to impersonate Derek's mate, while Elena was exiled. Years later, Derek travels south with the unhatched eggs and meets Elena. Her blood triggers their birth, bonding the family. They fake-marry, and romance blooms. Helena's dark plots fail when the dragon powers confirm Elena as the real mother, bringing peace at last.

description: Ron Hill's "All In" documentary is about a man who was reared in a challenging time. However, no matter what he did from Sports, Sin, to Salvation He was "All In!" We will take you on a journey to discover the scores he made during his game of life.

title: Diane Von Hoffman vs Sin-D
description: A 1 Fall Submissions Only Match. Sin-D’s proven herself to be a capable wrestler and has a considerable speed advantage here against Diane. She’ll certainly need to overcome Diane’s size, strength, and experience not to mention that much feared Clawhold the veteran keeps in her back pocket. Diane throws everyone off balance with a little pre-match flirting to a red-faced referee before bringing her power to bear against Sin-D. The quick Sin-D is soon caught in Diane’s powerful grasp, suffering in a Surfboard and Camel Clutch as the veteran uses her size advantage to bury her opponent. Sin-D manages to power out of the hold and targets the veteran’s legs with vicious kicks to slow her down and keep her off her feet. Diane returns the favor, working Sin-D’s ankle to the breaking point. Neither wrestler is willing to give up the match without a battle. Diane’s deadly Claw comes out, but Sin-D counters with a tight Sleeper of her own. Someone’s going down with a submission, but which will prove to be the more fatal hold?

title: Homemad(e)
description: Acclaimed Austrian documentary director Ruth Beckermann portrays a dying culture of Viennese urban history in HOMEMAD(E). The entertaining as well as insightful doc was shown at the Forum section of the Berlinale. The Marc-Aurel-Straße in Vienna. The last Jewish shop owner in the former textile disctrict, the Iranian hotelier, the cafe Salzgries with its regular customers. title: Giuseppe e Calogera
description: Giuseppe, a young woman from Matera has been forced to endure life with a boy's name. She yearns to become a mirror image of her older sister Calogera who ran away to Sicily several years before. Calogera has become disillusioned with the exotic Sicilian lifestyle she escaped to. She misses Giuseppe and the simple life of Matera and desperately wants to return home. Both sisters embark on a journey across southern Italy in search of each other, encountering challenges and haunting coincidences along the way. Giuseppe discovers a shocking truth about Calogera which not only creates doubt about the sister she thought she knew so well but forces her to reconsider her own existence.

title: F for Fontcuberta
description: Many truths are hidden to contemporary man. So it happens few are aware that the most ferocious predator is a rare species of oyster, that some amongst the most famous Soviet astronauts have been erased by History, that mermaids once truly existed in the French Alps. But in Barcelona there is a man who, despite himself, is the keeper of these uneasy truths: the Catalan photographer Joan Fontcuberta. The mockumentary F for Fontcuberta is a journey in the creative world of one of the most flamboyant contemporary artists and his incredible discoveries. A trip in the misty no mans land between fake and reality. Dedicated to the sceptics of all the world.

title: Raposinha F Evoluiu
description: O Felipe convocou uma raposinha ornamental nível F e foi humilhado. No limite, ele despertou um Sistema Divino. A raposinha mostrou sangue demoníaco, causou um fenômeno celestial, e o Felipe foi mandado para a mina. Após completar missões, a raposinha evoluiu para nível E e o Felipe ganhou poder de volta.

title: Milky G
description:
Michael Farlow (Milky G), like a lot of teens from the new millennium, aspire to be rappers; however growing up on the streets of Los Angeles in a crime infested neighborhood, played against Milky's goal of making it big. After witnessing his mother getting killed during a drug raid, the trauma lingers in his mind as several years pass. Milky moves out of his old neighborhood and into the suburbs entering a new charter high school of mostly white students.

Milky G meets a girl [SANDY HOLMES] in his class, a classical music major, who he falls in lust with. She gets him into the schools "world talent show", but Milky G can't stay away from the old neighborhood and ghetto friends. The relationship gets stormy. Milky G rejects the boogie world and while suppressing the pain of his mother's memory, continues to hang out, run the streets, make fast money, and craft his rapper identity. Milky's behavior and bad attitude lead to constant clashes with the police and court appearances. Milky makes a rap demo for the talent show with the help of Big Stack, studio owner, a legend in his own right in the world of hip-hop. Big Stack, knowing Milky's past - becomes his mentor.

Although Milky is focused on his music, he can't stay away from a life of crime. He needs some flash money so he can acquire that rapper look and get his props at the talent show. This all comes to a head when Milky G is talked into robbing a drug dealers house and it doesn't go good. Gangsters are after him and the police are too. Weary, and with nowhere to turn, Milky G. leans on what Big Stack taught him about life and decides to undo the harm he's done to himself and others. Repentant, he ends up at his mother's grave begging for forgiveness and promising to make things right. Although he's been scratched from the talent show, he forces his way onto the stage to give a rap tribute to his mother. The crowd goes wild, but he doesn't win. Milky G gains SANDY's favor as well as those close to him who want him to take a different path and become the man he was meant to be. Risking his life he decides to return the stolen goods to the thugs.

title: When G-Men Step In
description: Fred Garth (Don Terry) owns a printing establishment and poses as a business research expert, but actually runs several white-collar rackets operating by means of high-pressure telephone soliciting. He has sent his younger brother, Bruce Garth (Robert Paige), through law school with the intention of making him his legal watch-dog. But idealist Bruce enrolls as a Department of Justice investigator, and is detailed to track down charity and other phoney rackets. Both brothers are in love with attractive socialite Marjorie Drake (Julie Bishop as Jacqueline Wells), who is unaware of Fred's schemes and he uses her to meet other social leaders with pet charities and his salesmen sell them the program ads at five times the charity rate. Bruce and his partner Neale (Gene Morgan) trace the phone rackets to Bruce and a confrontation looms.

The detectives set out to bring the Pelican Boys to justice, but they soon find themselves in over their heads.The Pelican Boys are a ruthless gang with deep ties to the city's political and law enforcement establishment.The detectives must use all of their skills and resources to bring down the Pelican Boys, even if it means putting their own lives at risk.

title: H-H
description: The Rhodiacéta in Besancon is a former Rhône-Poulenc-owned textile factory. It became an emblematic site following the 1967 workers' movement and films made by the Medvedkine groups. In 2015, the city of Besancon decided to redevelop the site, which had fallen into ruin. When it came to the demolition of existing buildings, questions were raised about the possibility of retaining parts of them, but what to save, and how? During the redevelopment memories associated with the site were transformed and reincarnated; for example, you will be able to see the typography of a logo reflected in the lines of the new building. H-H by Chloé Malcotti focuses on the actions involved in their process, their meanings, their policies and the new relationships with the world which result.

title: Ms J Contemplates Her Choice
description: Jo Yang, a celebrity radio guest, receives a phone call while on air and sets in motion a series of events that threaten her life and her family. This film is loosely inspired by real-life events in Singapore, and explores how it is more choice rather than chance that shapes our lives.

title: Nevesta k zulíbání
description: Thirty-three-year-old architect Kveta (Dana Syslová) is an independent and energetic woman. She lives with her father (Jirí Pleskot), who reminds her in vain that she ought to get married. Despite her outward reserve, Kveta is a highly sensitive woman and she carefully registers the marital failures of the people around her. This is why in her private life she chooses a casual relationship with an senior lecturer and is so committed to her career.

title: What's Wrong with Secretary Kim [Hindi]
description: Follows the budding romance between a perfect but narcissistic second-generation heir and his capable assistant.

title: K.O. Beast [English]
description: Set in the distant future in which the Earth is split in two. The southern hemisphere is placed in another dimension while the inhabitants of the northern hemisphere are able to morph into beast-like humanoids. Eventually the humans of the southern hemisphere, led by Uranus, attack the Beasts. The Three Beasts, Wan Derbard (Wan Dabadadatta) of the Tiger Tribe, Bud Mint (Baado Mint) of the Bird Tribe, and Mei Mer (Mei Mah) of the Mermaid Tribe, are taken prisoner along with Mei Mer's companion Tuttle Millen (Mekka Mannen, also of the Mermaid tribe), but manage to escape thanks to a little girl named Yuuni Charm Password. Together they seek Gaia, which they believe to be a fabulous treasure, but they are pursued by Uranus's minions : V-Darn the vicious mage-knight, V-Sion the warrior woman and Akumako, V-Darn's sadistic imp-like partner.

title: A S K
description: Damian is on a journey to gain self-confidence, rid himself of his paralyzing anxiety, and to achieve his ultimate goal of becoming a person that others can admire and look up to. Through the series, we meet a colorful group of characters who challenge Damian's existence.

title: R. K. Laxman Ki Duniya
description: This TV series is based on the books and works of R. K. Laxman. The episodes and incidents would involve happenings in the life of the common man as depicted by Laxman over the years. This series would focus on the character of the common man who is a silent spectator of marching time. Meek and silent , the common man is a witness to everything: scheming politicians, gossiping housewives and rapacious bureaucrats.

title: Mr. Sunshine
description: A young boy who ends up in the U.S. after the 1871 Shinmiyangyo incident returns to Korea at a historical turning point and falls for a noblewoman.

title: L' AMOUR REND AVEUGLE
description:
Salut la famille , jespere que vous allez bien ? 
Aujourd’hui nous vous proposons  L'amour rend aveugle" est une comédie romantique captivante qui explore les complexités de l'amour et de l'attraction. Le film suit l'histoire d'Emma, une jeune femme idéaliste à la recherche du véritable amour. Cependant, sa quête prend une tournure inattendue lorsqu'elle tombe éperdument amoureuse de Tom, un homme charmant mais visiblement peu fiable. Alors qu'Emma est complètement envoûtée par son charme, elle est aveuglée par ses défauts flagrants et ses mensonges évidents.

Entre situations hilarantes et moments émouvants, "L'amour rend aveugle" offre un regard perspicace sur les illusions de l'amour et les choix difficiles auxquels nous sommes confrontés lorsque nos émotions prennent le dessus sur notre raison. Avec une distribution talentueuse et un scénario captivant, ce film est un incontournable pour tous les amateurs de romance qui cherchent une dose d'humour et de réflexion. title: Il 7 e l'8
description: 6th January 1975, in an infant nursery in Palermo (Italy), for a mysterious reason, a male nurse exchanges the labels of baby number 7 and 8. Thirty-one years later Tommaso (7) and Daniele (8) meet each other by accident. They are the perfect odd couple, Tommaso a pilferer while Daniele a quiet almost boring student. The accidental meeting will give the start to a turmoil of events till the two will discover the truth about their real identity. Obviously their status has to change in a complete opposite life style, and more at one point will be hard to understand who is son of whom, who is sister of whom etcetera. Add to this that a gangster wants to kill both and continuously pursues them everywhere in Palermo.

title: The Enchantment
description: On August 1st, 2023, Milan's historic Odeon cinema-a true Art Nouveau architectural gem in the heart of the city-closed its doors forever. The last film to be screened was Greta Gerwig's Barbie. In its place, after demolition, yet another luxury boutique will arise. Perhaps a supermarket. Perhaps yet another urban heterotopia, unable to reconcile with it, and for it, popular passions, social life, and cultural gathering. The city seems incapable of reacting to this kind of dispossession, with culture once again falling victim to unbridled capitalism eager to swiftly devour the places of the soul. The August atmosphere certainly does not encourage the will for a tangible awakening of awareness. And yet, all the major Italian media outlets speak of the event and sing the praises of the 'great beauty' embodied by the Odeon cinema. Tomaso Pessina takes us by the hand on a journey through his dearest family memories, which are at once a memoir of the lost architecture of his city-the Odeon cinema in Milan-and an excursus on the cinemas of Pupi Avati. A door left delicately ajar onto tenderness, melancholy, remembrance, but also the magical, the miraculous, the enchanting. Through a kaleidoscope of animations, testimonies, and scenes from films, woven together by the invisible yet persistent thread of memory, the narrative unfolds as the story of a soul-that of the city itself, of Pupi Avati's filmography, and, in its most spontaneous and authentic act of identity, of the director himself.

title: Detective L
description: Shanghai in the 30s: An intriguing crime case emerges amidst the bustling city. A beautiful new graduate of the police academy, Qin Xiao Man, joins the investigation unit. The famous detective Luo Fei becomes her colleague and neighbor.

description: A day in the life of the Jewish settlement of Hebron, the tomb of Abraham and the stronghold of the Israeli religious right.A polyphonic tale of spirituality and violence. Guns'n'Moses is a documentary about the Israeli ultra nationalist-religious settlers and their ideology in their own words . Their accounts interweave to create a fabric in which stand up their concepts of time and space, their idea of identity and enemy, the Divine plan underlying the daily life and the same use of the violence. Modern prophets carrying assault rifles, hippies devoted to the Cabala and the American folk music, techno-dancers longing for the Redemption and mothers proud to raise the future soldiers of the Messiah. In their own word and through their own eyes.

Their gratification is good grades, moral values they strive to impart to students.However, in an evil turn of events, a wicked lady, Kamini Gupta ( Divya Dutta) gets appointed as the School Principal, who earlier worked in the capacity of a Supervisor. She is extremely cunning by nature and monopolizes on every opportunity she can find her hands on. In a bid to make profits for the school, she decides to fire experienced teachers to replace them with fresher teachers. The saved funds of which she can boastfully present to the school trustees, at the cost of quality education. Vidya suffers a sudden heart attack due to her dismissal from school. The school management threatens the staff to cut ties with Vidya. At such a time, Jyoti stands up for her friend and colleague, Vidya. description: Fleeing from the orphanage where he was living, young Valdo immediately entered the life of the crime, establishing himself as a dangerous adult criminal. title: O Poeta
description: O POETA Marco Nicoletti's synopsis Junior would like to be a poet full-time, but he did not publish big thing, and is not really recognized in the Sao Paulo's poetry crowd. To contribute to maintain his small family (his wife Helena with whom he has an one-year-old baby girl, Aurora), he spends time showing apartments to customers who avoid them. As a matter of fact he's as much "successful" in the real estate as he is in the poetry... But the life in Sao Paulo is expensive, and his wife begin to worry about the incapacity of her husband to face reality... One day Junior purchases a ticket of the national lottery, and hide it in the shelves of the living room. Few days later, when he discovers that he eventually won the lottery, the ticket is lost... The Poet describes junior's increasing obsession for the lottery ticket, and its descent in the sheer madness. He eventually looks for the promised ticket in the dump of Sao Paulo (one of the largest on western world), and writes to the president Dilma, to get back the money he deserves. His desperate search allows us to make also an investigation on the emergent artists of contemporary Sao Paulo.

title: "P-Pangit!" binara ang pagkanta ni JACKIE! | It's Showtime
description:
It's the first day of school para sa maraming estudyante. Raise your hand kung excited kang bumalik sa classroom suot ang uniporme! Dito sa "It's Showtime," may extra points ang mga bibo. Don't worry dahil exam, kailangan lang pasado ka sa vibe check!

Kapag um-absent sa klase, mag-submit ng Excuse Letter kay ma'am! Si Vice Ganda, parang class adviser ang tanungan kay Vhong Navarro, na um-absent daw dahil sa ubo? Biro ni Meme, may nakarating sa kanyang kuwento. Ang sakit daw ni Vhong, hindi lang basta ubo? Sabi naman ng Mr. Suave, hindi gano'n ka-OA! He's perfectly okay!

Rated P! As in PASADO ang mga P-POP cuties na kasali sa 'Laro Laro Pick' game arena. Present ang WRIVE, 1621, VXON, AJAA, Cloud 7, at YGIG. Kalahati ng mapapanalunan ng lucky player ay ido-donate sa Helping Hands Healing Hearts Ministries.

Dahil P-Pop members ang bisita, kantahan at sayawan ay hindi mawawala. Nagpakitang-gilas sina VXON Sam at Franz, at nagbigay ng advice sa mga aspiring P-Pop stars. Pero kung si Jackie Gonzaga ang mag-o-audition, biro ni Meme, hindi papasa dahil P-Pop, as in P-Pangit ang boses ni Jackie. Aray naman, Meme!

Umaray rin si Vice Ganda nang mapag-usapan ang role ni Franz sa grupo. Dahan-dahan lang daw sa pagsabi ng 'MAIN VOCAL.' IYKYK. Baka pwedeng 'mang-aawit' na lang?

Pagkatapos ng fun challenges, si um-arrive ang swerte para kay Ishiro ng grupong WRIVE. Sinubukan ni Kim Chiu na kumbinsihin si Ishiro na tanggapin ang Li-Pot offer. Pero, nag-goodbye siya agad sa P20,000 para sa chance na sagutin ang P100,000 POT question.


Kung first day ng school para sa ibang estudyante, first day rin ng Grand Finals ng Tawag Ng Tanghalan Ika-10 Taon.

Sa unang araw ng bakbakan, sina Crisler Aporbo (Region XIII), Timmy Go (CAR), at Charlie Palalisan (Region XII) ang naglaban-laban,

Swabe ang tama ng performance ni Crisler, na binigyan ng bagong tunog ang classic OPM rock song na "Laklak." Dahil papalapit na sa dulo, itinodo na ni Timmy ang talento at ginawang mas masarap ang tunog ng "Saving All My Love For You." Abot-langit naman ang feels sa mapusong pag-awit ni Charlie ng "In The Stars" by Benson Boone.

Para sa Grand Finals, magkakaroon ng Round 2 ang bawat laban. Muling nagharap ang Top 2 scorers of the day, sina Charlie at Crisler. Sa ikalawang round, parehong naging mapuso ang pag-awit ni Charlie ng "Kung Wala Ka" oroginally by Hale, at ni Crisler, na ginawang ballad ang "Di Ko Na Mapipigilan" ng The Sexbomb Girls.

Parehong nagbigay ng matinding laban pero sa araw na ito, isa lang ang pwedeng umangat sa tanghalan. At ito ay si Charlie, na nakakuha ng score ng 93%.

title: Laugh trip! Vice, pinakita kung paano umangkas sa motor!
description:
HuweBEST kantahan ang sumalubong sa Madlang People! Isang pangmalakasang Air Supply performance ang pinerform nina "Tawag Ng Tanghalan" male champions JM Dela Cerna, Christian Tibayan, Riven Umali, JM Yosures, at Yannie Basical.

Magulo man ang usapan paminsan-minsan pero ang talakan ay naitatawid naman. Tamang laro lang sa "Miss Q and A" with candidates Cola Jane, Veena Loca Latak, at Ramona Baluno.

Na-test ang patience ni Vice Ganda dahil sa mga kandidata. Medyo not listening ang mga 'vadeng' kaya si Meme Vice, gulong-gulo sa usapan, pero gayunpaman, hindi mapigil ang halakhakan. Si Ramona, may malaking problema. Hindi siya nakapag-exam sa eskwela dahil daw sa "Miss Q and A," kaya ang sabi ni Meme, ayaw niyang madamay sa kabulastugan ng kandidata.

Hirit ni Meme, bagsak na sa school, 'lotlot' pa sa contest dahil si Ramona ang unang naligwak sa Tumpak Ganern round. Samantala, sa WIT Lang, umikot man nang bahagya pero nakarating naman sa finish line ang chukchak ni Cola sa tanong na, "Naha-heartbroken din ba ang puso ng saging?" Full of confidence rin ang pagtalak ni Veena as she took on the question, "Sino ang magulang ng anak pawis?"

Ang mga taga-Malabon, kumasa sa hamon. Sino kaya ang pinaka-lucky sa Laro Laro Pick game arena ngayon?

Aliw na medyo 'loading' at 'struggle is real' ang kuwentuhan ng hosts with nanay Marita, na tubong-Malabon talaga. Maya-maya pa, si Vice Ganda napagod na. Pero na-touch din siya sa kabutihan ni Marita, na pinaalala sa kan'ya ang lambing ng isang ina.

Chill naman ang chikahan with Jocar, na mula sa pagiging rider ay magsisimula na sa bagong trabaho sa call center. Paano nga ba dapat umangkas sa motor? Si Vice Ganda, may pag-demo! Sa paalog-alog niyang galawan, siguradong ika'y mapapa-LOL!

Ang swerte ay dumapo kay player Mari. Para bang lucky charm niya ang kanyang 'moon' tattoo na simbolo ng 'liwanag sa dilim.' Speaking of tattoos, ni-reveal din ni Vice Ganda ang dalawa sa tattoos niya, while the other hosts shared kung ano ang gusto nilang ipa-tattoo kung may pagkakataon.

title: Thank you, Meme! TYPHOON VICTIMS, nakatanggap ng P700k
description:
Nabalot ng P-pop feels ang buong studio, at nabalot din ng pag-asa ang puso ng mga typhoon victims na kasali sa Laro Laro Pick, sa ikalawang araw ng 16th anniversary special na unang ipinalabas noong December 2, 2025.

Itinaas agad ni Darren Espanto ang energy sa studio with his version of "Dungka" by P-pop Kings SB19. Walang patid ang excitement as he passed on the spotlight to VXON. Present din DNA, 1621, WRIVE, and G22 to show us what they’ve got. And all the ladies in the studio, kinilig sa performance ng BGYO. Na-surprise naman ang lahat sa debut ng pinakabagong “It’s Showtime” girl group. Isang red hot version ng “Pantropiko” ang regalo nina Kim Chiu, Jackie Gonzaga, Cianne Dominguez at Anne Curtis–the SWT16. Sino ang bias mo? Present din sa studio si BINI member Gwen Apuli para mag-cheer sa buong P-pop community.

It’s the season of giving! Maagang pamasko ang handog ng “It’s Showtime” sa mga typhoon victims mula Isabela, Catanduanes, at Aurora na sumalang sa “Laro Laro Pick.” Ikinuwento nina Joan, Ayen, at Nestor ang naging karanasan sa gitna ng baha at landslide. Halos lahat sila ay nawalan ng tahanan, at may iba namang nawalan ng mahal sa buhay.

Kuwento ng kabayanihan naman ang bitbit ni Tata sa “Laro Laro Pick” arena. Isa ang pamilya niya sa mga nasalanta ng mga nagdaang bagyo. Pero nakakahanga ang kabutihan at tapang ni Tata, na kinalimutan ang sarili at mas inuna ang pagsagip sa isang matandang kapitbahay at mga alagang hayop na nangangailangan ng rescue kaysa isalba ang sariling mga gamit, na kalaunan ay sinira ng baha.

Bukod sa P10,000 na maagang ipinamigay bago magsimula ang games sa “Laro Laro Pick,” umulan pa ng mas maraming papremyo. Ang mga nakarating sa dulo ng laro, nakaipon ng P16,000. Pero ang pinakamalaking swerte ay dumapo kay Banang, ang nakapili ng lucky balloons sa PILImination round.

Sabi ni Banang, kung masaya na siya sa P5,000 ay mas lalo pang malaking tulong ang P300,000 na offer sa Li-Pot. Kaya pinili niya ito kaysa sa P1 million Pot question. Mas bumuhos naman ang luha at saya sa buong studio nang ipamigay ni Vice Ganda ang natitirang P700,000 mula sa P1 million jackpot money. Ang P700,000 ay paghahati-hatian ng remaining players na mga typhoon victims.

title: P-POP Domination
description:
Nabalot ng P-pop feels ang buong studio, at nabalot din ng pag-asa ang puso ng mga typhoon victims na kasali sa Laro Laro Pick, sa ikalawang araw ng 16th anniversary special na unang ipinalabas noong December 2, 2025.

Itinaas agad ni Darren Espanto ang energy sa studio with his version of "Dungka" by P-pop Kings SB19. Walang patid ang excitement as he passed on the spotlight to VXON. Present din DNA, 1621, WRIVE, and G22 to show us what they’ve got. And all the ladies in the studio, kinilig sa performance ng BGYO. Na-surprise naman ang lahat sa debut ng pinakabagong “It’s Showtime” girl group. Isang red hot version ng “Pantropiko” ang regalo nina Kim Chiu, Jackie Gonzaga, Cianne Dominguez at Anne Curtis–the SWT16. Sino ang bias mo? Present din sa studio si BINI member Gwen Apuli para mag-cheer sa buong P-pop community.

It’s the season of giving! Maagang pamasko ang handog ng “It’s Showtime” sa mga typhoon victims mula Isabela, Catanduanes, at Aurora na sumalang sa “Laro Laro Pick.” Ikinuwento nina Joan, Ayen, at Nestor ang naging karanasan sa gitna ng baha at landslide. Halos lahat sila ay nawalan ng tahanan, at may iba namang nawalan ng mahal sa buhay.

Kuwento ng kabayanihan naman ang bitbit ni Tata sa “Laro Laro Pick” arena. Isa ang pamilya niya sa mga nasalanta ng mga nagdaang bagyo. Pero nakakahanga ang kabutihan at tapang ni Tata, na kinalimutan ang sarili at mas inuna ang pagsagip sa isang matandang kapitbahay at mga alagang hayop na nangangailangan ng rescue kaysa isalba ang sariling mga gamit, na kalaunan ay sinira ng baha.

Bukod sa P10,000 na maagang ipinamigay bago magsimula ang games sa “Laro Laro Pick,” umulan pa ng mas maraming papremyo. Ang mga nakarating sa dulo ng laro, nakaipon ng P16,000. Pero ang pinakamalaking swerte ay dumapo kay Banang, ang nakapili ng lucky balloons sa PILImination round.

Sabi ni Banang, kung masaya na siya sa P5,000 ay mas lalo pang malaking tulong ang P300,000 na offer sa Li-Pot. Kaya pinili niya ito kaysa sa P1 million Pot question. Mas bumuhos naman ang luha at saya sa buong studio nang ipamigay ni Vice Ganda ang natitirang P700,000 mula sa P1 million jackpot money. Ang P700,000 ay paghahati-hatian ng remaining players na mga typhoon victims.

title: Miss Q&A
description:
Get your Saturday dose of motivation mula kina Vhong Navarro, Jhong Hilario, at Vice Ganda, na nagbahagi ng mensahe as we celebrate World Mental Heath Day.

Paalala ng trio, magpahinga. Sabi nga ni Meme Vice, ang pahinga ay hindi dapat reward lamang matapos mapagod o maubos ang lakas, kundi dapat bahagi ng routine. Hindi kailangang hintaying sagad na sagad na tayo bago huminto at huminga.

Libre lang talaga ang mangarap kaya lakasan ang loob. Sa pamamagitan ng talak na maningning, abutin ang mga bituin. Isang pangmalakasang "Miss Q and " weekly finals ang hatid nina Jeraldine Brittany Hawthorne, JC Ibale, Arci Simon, Jass Lucky, Cola Jane, at Angel Umbac.

Mula sa anim na weekly finalists, apat ang umabante sa Wit Lang round, hanggang ang Top 2 na sina Cola Jane at Arci ang nag-face off sa Beklamation kung saan nasubok ang kanilang paniniwala nang tanungin kung papayag ba sila na may girl best friend ang kanilang boyfriend.

POT money na P100,000 ang goal na masungkit ng mga taga-Caniogan na sumabak sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, with hosts Karylle, Ogie Alcasid, at guest co-host Bianca Umali.

Si player Emo, still waiting for 'the one.' Kaya si Ogie, may payo. Huwag mag-alinlangan na ipagdasal ang taong hinahanap at hinihintay ng puso. Pagpapautang ng biskwit naman ang hanapbuhay ni Glo. Medyo magulo lang mala-slow burn na usapan pero nakarating naman!

Tingnan mo nga naman, sina Emo at Gloria ang natira sa You Gotta Lyric round. Pero hindi nila nahulaan ang pamagat ng mga kanta sa eksena, kaya bumunot ng eliminated player na maglalaro sa jackpot round, at ito ay si Doris.

title: Miss Q&A BEKLAMATION
description:
Sa isang Sabadong makulay, mga beki na fierce ang nagpamalas ng wit at nagpalaganap ng good vibes sa unang weekly finals ng "Miss Q and A."

Kanya-kanyang paandar sa pagrampa sina Miss Jawo ng Antipolo City, Kelly Agustin ng Nueva Ecija, Elisse Kagandahan Alamo ng Quezon City, Miss Mia ng Malolos Bulacan, Andrea Jane ng Del Monte Quezon City, at Barbie Bratz Ayuda ng Trece Martires Cavite.

Agad uminit ang puksaan ng mga kandidata dahil lahat ay sumabak with full confidence. Sina Barbie Bratz at Miss Jawo, mainit ang dugo sa isa't isa. Kaya biro ni Vice Ganda, kung sino pang magkamukha, sila pa ang nag-aaway!

Mula sa anim na nagpabilisan at nagpatalinuhan sa 'TumPAK Ganern' round, apat lang ang umabante sa 'WIT Lang' kung saan self-expression at pagiging creative sa mga sagot ang naging labanan. Sina Miss Jawo, Barbie, Kelly at Elisse ang pumasok sa second round.

At mula naman sa kanilang apat, sina Miss Jawo ang Kelly ang nag-face-off sa BEKLAMATION kung saan iisang tanong lamang ang kanilang sinagot. Ito ay kung anong makeup product ang ibibigay nila sa kanilang tatay.

Parehong 'lipstick' ang naisip nilang sagot, pero nagkaiba sa lalim ng paliwanag. Mas tumatak kina hurado Alexa Ilacad, Ralph de Leon, at Nicole Cordoves ang talak ni Kelly, kaya siya ang itinanghal na Miss Q and A Reyna TalakERA of the week! Nakakuha si Kelly ng average score na 9.3, samantalang 8 naman ang grado ni Miss Jawo.

Masaya ang selebrasyon para sa mga tatay na puno ng dedikasyon. Minsan seryoso, minsan ay korni ang banat. Pero kahit magkakaiba, pagmamahal at sipag nila ay palaging sapat. Happy Father's Day sa mga madlang tatay!

Saludo tayo sa pagsisikap ni Mel, ang hardworking daddy, na walang sinasayang na oras sa pag-aalaga at pagtatrabaho for his family. Perfect naman for the celebration ang good vibes na dala ng Showtime hosts na sumalang sa bagong paboritong aktingan ng bayan, ang 'You Gotta Lyric' round.

Sina Vice at Vhong Navarro, parang na-enjoy ang 'physical' acting... parang totoo?! Heto ang siguradong totoo, para kay Mel ang araw na 'to! Matapos ma-eliminate ang lahat ng players, pangalan niya ang nabunot para maglaro sa jackpot round.

Dahil minsan lang ang ganitong experience, hindi nagpatinag si Mel na piliin ang POT question. May reward from the universe ang masisipag at matatapang! Dahil sa pagsugal niya sa POT, naiuwi ni Mel ang papremyong P300,000!

title: Miss Q&A Pau Chiu
description:
I-on ang playlist at maki-sound trip with hip-hop artist J Rose, na ipinarinig ang bago niyang single at ibinahagi ang kuwento sa likod nito.

Makitawa naman sa mga kandidatang laban na laban sa Miss Q and A. Sa kanilang mga talak, atensyon mo'y mahahatak! Palaban sa puksaan sina Andrea Lim ng Pampanga, Rhian Orain ng Valenzuela, at Pau Chiu ng Manila.

Ang pangalan ni Candidate No. 3, inspired by Chinita Princess Kim Chiu, na 'peg' niya at idolo. Pero sa paningin ni Vice Ganda, hindi naman si Kim ang kanyang nakikita. Para bang deja vu, namalikmata si Meme at nakita si Tado! Biro niya, "Si Candidate #3 ay nakaaway ko no'ng Season 1." Baka ito na nga ang 'closure' na inaabangan.

Hirit ni Meme, "Mga bakla, aral-aral din." Pero sa hinaba-haba man ng kulitan, may dalwang kandidata na umabante sa second round, at ito ay sina Andrea at Pau. Ang tanong kay Andrea, "Papayag ka ba na marami kang pera pero na kay Vice Ganda?" At si Pau naman, natanong kung papayag siyang maging doktor kahit madali siyang mahawa ng mga sakit.

Pagkatapos ng WIT Lang, si Andrea ang pinusuan nina hurado Karylle, Brent Manalo, at Miss Grand International 2025 Emma Tiglao, at itinanghal na Reyna TalakEra of the day.

Sa araw na 'to, mga taga-Mahabang Parang, Angono Rizal ang bumida sa Laro Laro Pick game arena. Kapag nagsama-sama naman ang Showtime hosts sa 'You Gotta Lyric' round, ibig sabihin, masaya ang aktingan. Si Lassy, pinagtulungan na buhatin. Teka, saan n'yo siya dalahen?

Best friends ni Christian ang mga alagang baboy dahil sila ang nagdadala sa kanya ng swerte at kabuhayan. Kaya 'pag nakuha niya ang P100,000 sa paglalaro sa jackpot round, ang mga alagang baboy, sure na madadagdagan.

title: Vhong may kakaibang epekto sa isang Miss Q&A
description:
Ang jamming at throwback vibes for this video, hatid ng "Pinoy Dream Academy" crooners na sina RJ Jimenez, Geoff Taylor, Chad Peralta at Jay-R Siaboc na may magandang balita sa fans!

Sa Miss Q and A, kakaibang comedy collab ang hatid nina Vhong Navarro, MC at Lassy, at Brent Manalo, na sanib-pwersa sa pakikipagkulitan sa tatlong kandidata.

Say hello and mabuhay sa pagdating nina Queen Natnat, MJ Perfecto, at Wri Wri Laurora, na sa talakan ay bigay na bigay. Forda kuwento si Queen tungkol sa history ng kanyang name. Heto ang chika, siya ang queen ng tatay niya, at dahil sa solid na suporta ng mga magulang, akala niya tunay siyang babae noong siya'y bata pa lamang.

Feeling reyna rin si Wri Wri, na nangatog sa kilig nang mahawakan ang crush niyang si Vhong Navarro. Hindi naman nagpatalo si Lassy, na feeling leading lady ni Brenty. Pero hindi makakapayag si MC na hindi basagin ang fantasy ni Lassy, kaya ang kuwentuhan ay nauwi sa puksaan.

Puksaan malala ang ladies na nagpaunahan sa pagpindot at pagsagot sa Tumpak Ganern round, hanggang tuluyang naligwak si Queen Natnat. Nagtuloy-tuloy ang chukchakan sa Wit Lang. Para sa mga hurado, 'perfecto' ang kanyang answer. Kaya naman sa araw na 'to, siya ang kinoronahang winner.

Panalo ang matapang tumalak. Parang si Ryan Bang na tumatapang sa harap ni Max Collins!

At, tamang timpla ng tapang at positivity ang perfect recipe para maging malasa ang swerte sa Laro Laro Pick, kung saan mga canteen staff muna ang bumida.

Mukhang may nilulutong pag-ibig sa game arena. Ang tinginan nina Dondon at Menang, para bang may kakaibang tamis na sa puso malalasahan. Eh, sa love triangle nina Darren Espanto, Jackie Gonzaga, at Brent Manalo, sino ang ship mo?

Matamis din ang love story ni Mylene, at mukhang ito ang nagdala sa kanya ng swerte, kaya sa jackpot round, siya ang umabante.

title: Brent handang ipakilala si Miss Q&A Agua sa pamilya
description:
Ngayong July 3 and every day, ang tawanan sa "It's Showtime ay free. Kasama ang mga kandidata ng Miss Q and A, ang good vibes ay times three!

Sina Agua ng Parañaque City, Raux Araneta ng Negros Occidental at Kyla ng Laguna, kanya-kanyang paandar sa pagpapakilala sa Madlang People. Pero ang pinakagusto nilang makilala, eh 'di ang mga crush nila! Parang Valentine's season sa buwan ng Hulyo, kilig ng ladies ay todo-todo dahil kina Michael Sager, Ralph de Leon, at Brent Manalo.

Pero hindi lang crush ang kayang nilang ipaglaban, dahil pati sa social issues ay hindi matitinag ang kanilang paninindigan. Syempre, namana nila ang tapang ni Vice Ganda, na hindi matatakot 'ipahiya' ang mga magnanakaw, lalo na 'yung mga sangkot sa flood control scam, kung sakaling makasabay niya ito sa daan. Pero kung guwardiyado ang magnanakaw, teka lang, ibang usapan na 'yan.

Mukhang na-inspire ang mga kandidata kina Michael, Ralph at Brent dahil sa unang round ay mabilis ang kanilang pagpindot at pagsagot. Sina Agua at Raux ang nanguna sa Tumpak Ganern at nag-face off sa Round 2 na Wit Lang.

Parehong magaling! Mga answers nila ay winning! Kaya naman 'it's a tie' ang resulta. Sa araw na 'to, mayroon tayong dalawang Miss Q&A Reyna TalakEra.

Sa pinakabagong inaabangan na 'teleserye' sa tanghalian, ang You Gotta Lyric portion ng Laro Laro Pick, pang-finale ang eksena nina Vice Ganda bilang MemeRimar at Vhong Navarro bilang Sergio.

From aktingan, back to hosting si Vice Ganda upang papiliin si Duday, ang lucky player from Mandaluyong, kung Pot o Li-Pot ba ang desisyon niya. Wala nang patumpik-tumpik pa, Li-Pot offer ay itinodo na! Kaya hindi na rin nagdalawang-isip si Duday, at tinanggap na ang Li-Pot.

Ngunit laking pagsisisi ni Duday dahil nang subukan ang POT question, tama sana ang sagot niya. Pero tulad ng ipinangako ni Vice Ganda, dinagdagan niya ng P5,000 ang papremyo ni Duday sa oras na makasagot ito nang tama.

title: Miss Q&A Arah at Jhong, binalikan ang pagkikita nila noon
description:
Para bang inatake ng mga langgam ang buong studio dahil sa sweetness nina Bianca De Vera at Dustin Yu, na sa tinginan pa lang ay walang sinabi ang tikoy sa sobrang lagkit. Ano nga ba ang pinakakilig na ginagawa nila sa isa't isa? Kung si Dustin ay kinikilig sa luto ni Bianca, si Bianca naman ay solb na ang kilig sa ngiti pa lang ni Dustin.

Nag-hello ang mga reyna na ready to claim the korona sa Miss Q and A. Meet Anora Laforteza ng Pampanga, Ian Torres ng Manila, at Arah David ng Taguig. Baon nila ay wit na super big at personality na kaibig-ibig.

Pati si Jhong Hilario ay hindi nakaiwas sa charisma ng fangirl na si Arah. Lotlot man siya sa kompetisyon, feeling winner pa rin si Arah dahil sa moments nila ni Kuys Jhong. Samantala, 'may bitaw' ang talak nina Ian at Anora as they faced their respective questions sa Wit Lang round.

Nabunot ni Ian ang tanong na, "Sino ang mas badtrip kainuman, 'yung tumatakas o 'yung natutulog?" As a kanin lover, napangiti si Anora sa nabunot niyang tanong, "Ano ang mas bad trip? Walang ulam o walang sinaing?"

Parang tumatawag ang swerte sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, kaya napasugod ang mga taga-Parang, Marikina.

Agad bumuhos ang emosyon sa laro dahil sa life story ni player Kalbo, na tinitiis ang pagod at hirap para tulungan ang mga pamangkin sa kanilang mga pangarap. Samantala, si Darren Espanto, humingi ng space kay Jackie Gonzaga. Our DaCkie hearts! Huhu! Pero mabuti na lang aktingan lang 'to!

Sa pagtitinda ng prutas itinataguyod ni Eka at ng mister niya ang pamilya. Dito sa Laro Laro Pick, wish niya sana'y magbunga nang magandang biyaya ang kanyang pagpili kung tatanggapin ang Li-Pot offer o susugalan ang tanong para sa POT money.

title: Miss Q&A candidate, hinalikan ni Jhong
description:
Umeksena sa giyera ng mga matatalinghaga sina Nadimunyo Lustre, Adam Lambert, Binibining Heaven Jumawan, Stacey Doroteo, at ang nag-tie na candidates last Friday na sina Nadie Marie Fernandez at Belle Tinkerbell.

Sinala ni Vice Ganda ang kuwento at talento ng mga kandidata, at super na-touch nga siya sa good news ni Heaven na babalik na ito sa eskwela. Pagkatapos huminto nang isang taon dahil sa kakulangang pinansyal, ready to pursue her college education na si Heaven, na na-inspire sa naunang payo ni Meme Vice tungkol sa kahalagahan ng pag-aaral. Nasabi noon ni Vice na gusto niyang mag-aral si Heaven, hindi para sa ibang tao, kundi para sa kan'yang sariling kinabukasan.

Naging mabilis ang pindutan at sagutan sa Tumpak Ganern round, hanggang sa tuluyang nalotlot ang dalawang crowd favorites na sina Nadimunyo Lustre at Belle Tinkerbell. Ang apat na nakasagot naman ay umabante sa Wit Lang para humarap sa playtime questions.

Mula apat, ang Top 2 na sina Nadie at Adam ang nag-face-off sa next round, ang Beklamation, kung saan pareho nilang hinarap ang tanong na, "Sa tingin mo, bakit ka binibigyan ng mga biyayang sa pakiramdam mo ay hindi mo naman deserve?"

Ihiwalay ang de-kolor sa puti, dahil baka ngayong araw ay mas bumango pa ang swerte. Pahinga muna sa paglalaba ang mga laundry shop staff mula Metro Manila para mag-enjoy sa Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Siyempre, hindi kumpleto ang laro kung walang Act-Song! Si Vice Ganda, trip ang eksena ni Jugs Jugueta, at tawang-tawang pina-take two pa niya! Biro naman ni Meme, bet na bet ni Ryan Bang ang eksena niya kasama si Baby Doll Ariel. Hindi rin nakaligtas si Ogie Alcasid sa kulitan nang siya naman ang pagdiskitahan.

Si Jess ang umabot sa Jackpot Round para subukang maiuwi ang ₱450,000 POT. Pero bago ang matinding desisyon, pumili muna si Jess kung sino ang pinakapoging host. Kung si Ogie Alcasid daw ang most ahndsome of them all, nag-unahan naman sina Darren Espanto, Brent Manalo, at Ralph de Leon na kumbinsihin si Jess kung sino sa kanila ang karapat-dapat maging runner-up.

title: Ms. Castro umupo bilang Miss Q&A hurado
description:
Sagot na ni JM Dela Cerna ang pangmalakasang harana. Parang hugis 'otso,' to infinity and beyond ang husay ni JM sa entablado. Pati 'What's up, Madlang People' ibinirit nang todo.

Great ang performance ng tatlong beki na nagtalakan sa Miss Q and A, na sina Ral Imperial ng Batangas, Carla Flores Argonza ng Pangasinan, at Martie Anne Panlilio ng Tarlac.

Hindi 'puchu-puchu' ang tatlong ito, na pare-parehong may napatunayan na sa kanilang pag-aaral. Si Ral ay may dalawang Latin honors, si Carla naman ay may double degree, at si Martie ay scholar.

Na-earn nina Ral at Carla ang respeto ng mga hurado sa talak nilang galing sa puso at pinag-isipan during the Wit Lang round. Nabunot ni Ral ang tanong na, "Sa iyong palagay, saan mas hirap si Rapunzel, mag-blower o mag-shampoo?" Kalmado rin ang pagsagot ni Carla sa tanong na, "Kung huling hininga mo na, anong mas gusto mo, pa-inhale o pa-exhale?"

Markado ang sagot ni Carla kina hurados Ralph de Leon, Nicole Cordoves, at Esnyr na nagbihis bilang Ms. Castro, isa sa mga karakter sa kanyang online series.

Sa Laro Laro Pick, lahat ay swerte, walang malas. Kaya positive vibes lang ang dala ng mga taga-Navotas. Ang laro, nauwi sa concert nang maka-face off ni player Diane si Baby Doll Johaira sa sayawan at kantahan.

Naubos ang players sa It's Giving round kaya bumunot ng dalawang sasabak sa You Gotta Lyric, at ito ay sina Roland at Dindin. Lahat ay lucky pero si Dindin ang may pinakabonggang swerte.

Si Dindin, isang mananahi na solo parent, maingat na pumili. Kung ang kasamang anak ay forda experience ang gusto, si Nanay Dindin, mas gustong maging sigurado at tinanggap ang P40,000 Li-Pot offer.

title: Breaking Muse winner Verna, hurado sa Miss Q&A!
description:
Si Will Ashley, may bagong paborito? Na-miss daw ng ex-"PBB Collab" housemate ang Madlang People, kaya super happy siyang makabalik with good news and performance featuring his debut single na “Paborito.”

Classic OPM feels naman ang hatid ng isa pang bisita na si Ivy Violan, na thankful sa success ng OPM.

Pumasok sa "It's Showtime" area of responsibility ang Signal No. 4 na lakas ng tatlong kandidatang nagbabalik para sa Resbakulawan round–sina Bong Bong Tagulao, Adam Lambert, at Manika.

Patunay si Bong Bong na hindi lamang iisa ang mukha ng masaya at mapagmahal na pamilya. Twenty-one years strong na ang pagsasama nila ng partner, at may dalawa na silang anak. Ipinakilala ni Bong Bong ang partner at anak kay Vice Ganda, na na-touch dahil proud na proud sina Bong Bong sa binuong ‘modern family.’

title: Vice, ‘PINAGALITAN’ si Lola Move sa Miss Q&A
description:
Pagkatapos ng weekend na makulimlim at maulan, sa wakas ay sumilip na ang haring araw. Parang sunshine, nagpasikat din si Tawag Ng Tanghalan The School Showdown champ at ex-PBB Collab 2.0 housemate Carmelle Collado with her hot na hot na talento.

Pero ano 'tong 'bigay' ni Vice Ganda. Si Carmelle, may pinananabikan na "kamao?" Ahhh, kamao ni Anton Vinzon pala! Eh, 'yung kamao ni Darren Espanto, diretso akbay kay Jackie Gonzaga.

Ang kanilang mga beauty at personality na naghatid ng laughter, certified pang-main character. Good vibes ay solb kasama sina AZ Sasaki, Mitch Anne Lorenzo y Parizcova, at Lola Move.

Hindi pa man tumatalak, feeling winner na si AZ sa halik ng 'oppa' na kanyang kinakikiligan, si Ryan Bang! At kung ang choreographer na si Mitch ay super groove, hindi naman nagpakabog si Lola Move.

Kung ang talak ng isang lola ay may dalang wisdom, ang talak naman ni Candidate No. 3 ay may dalang katatawanan. Lahat ng gusto ng Madlang People ay kanyang gagawin, mapa-interpretative dancing tapos sa floor ay may pa-rolling, o ala Ogie Diaz workshop na acting. Pero walang biased sa edad dito, dahil kahit lola ay 'napagalitan' ni Vice Ganda, muntik pang ma-olats dahil bida-bida?

Bida nga talaga si Lola dahil sa Tumpak Ganern round siya ang frst to slay, at sinundan naman ni AZ. Time to face-off sa Wit Lang! Wala nang waiting pa, dahil agad-agad kung kumuda ang dalawang kandidata.

Hindi mumunti, kundi malaki ang swerteng dumapo sa mga residente ng Poblacion, Muntinlupa City na bumida sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, sa July 13 episode ng “It’s Showtime.”

Inspiration para sa buong nation ang ibinahagi ni Bel, ang loving mommy na pilit nilalakasan ang loob sa kalagayan ng anak na nagka-mild stroke sa edad na 6. Mahirap man ang laban ng buhay, nand'yan naman si hubby na kanyang kaagapay.

Pero hindi rin nawawala ang pag-e-enjoy. Si hubby, basketball ang hilig at paboritong player si... Michael V? Ay, Michael Jackson! Parehong mali! Kaya para sa sakyan ang trip ng mister ni Bel, kanya-kanyang pabida ng MJ moves ang "It's Showtime" family.

Michael Jackson na Gen Z ba kamo? Sagot 'yan ni Darren Espanto! Nakakatunaw naman sa kilig ang version ng MJ moves ni Brent Manalo, at ang kay Ralph de Leon ay pang-judo. Napalaban si Ralph at para bang napadasal nang muntik siyang matumba habang binubuhat si Ogie Alcasid. Laugh trip! Solid!

Solid din ang aktingan sa You Gotta Lyric round. Aktingan lang 'to, pero 'yung hurt ni Lassy parang totoo. Sagot kasi ng player sa eksena niya, "Mabaho!"

Nangamoy swerte ang jackpot round kasama si player Edmar, isang store crew, na tawang-tawa sa trip nina Vice Ganda. Nonchalant and shy lang siya no'ng una pero lumabas ang magandang ngiti nang mapag-usapan ang pangarap para sa mga supling.

At para sa mga anak, mas pinili ni Edmar ang siguradong panalo. Li-Pot offer na P35,000 tinanggap nang buong puso. But for the sake of fun and more papremyo, nag-promise si Vice Ganda na ang pera ni Edmar ay dadagdagan niya ng limang libo kapag nasagot pa rin nito nang tama ang Pot question. Maka-score kaya si Edmar ng dagdag pampa-happy?

title: My 1980's
description: Highlights the rebellious young generation of artists in China fighting for political emancipation, artistic freedom and creating a cultural golden age during the 1980s - a significant decade of transformational change. Interweaving six main characters' memories with the director's personal narration, the film embarks on an emotional journey and tells a story of being passionate and idealistic before dreams are dashed to pieces.

title: Mis(s)Communication
description: Fleeing her pageant career in disgrace, plucky diva Imogen stumbles upon a new career as a standardized patient, an actor for medical students. But life outside the spotlight proves harder than she thought.

title: [S]comparse
description: On a small, isolated island between Sicily and Africa, a film crew lands to shoot a large-scale feature film. The filmmaker and his entourage settle on the island providing employment to the locals, but disrupting their bucolic daily rhythm. A large group of Africans are brought to the Island from Sicily, to work as background on the film. The job requires that they get into the water and interpret the part of refugees arriving by rickety boat, something most of them have actually experienced.

title: s/y Glädjen
description: A young couple, Annika and Klas, have lost their 8-year-old son in a fire and are fighting to get back to life. During the family's journey, both the son and the father in the family died. Annika becomes obsessed by the fate of the family, and decides to find out everything about them. The movie follows both stories in parallel.

title: 90's House

title: Famous T&A 2

Hosted by the iconic Diana Prince (sidekick to horror host Joe Bob Briggs in Shudder's hit series THE LAST DRIVE-IN), this sequel is so hot your screen will singe.

title: Kato apo t' astra
description: Phoebe takes Loukas from free Cyprus to occupied Cyprus to see his village after years. While both of their parents were victims of the invasion, he refuses to get over it, while she even smuggles with the Turks to survive.

title: Sh*t Saves the World
description: This documentary provides an intriguing and humorous glimpse into our species' impact on the Earth by exploring how one of the most simple and obvious solutions to aid the environment may lie in what we often look down upon as waste. It just may be that the hero we all need, but don't deserve, shall be apparent when 'Sh*t Saves the World.'

title: 100% T-Shirt
description: We encounter it on a daily basis. Easy to produce, it is the most universal and basic piece of clothing. From Paris to Tokyo, including Ouagadougou, we all own at least one T-shirt: to sleep in, to run in, to work in, to express ourselves artistically, or to promote our political beliefs. The T-shirt has gone from undershirt to personal medium and creative outlet. Over 50 years, it has achieved a special status and is one of our best-selling pieces of clothing. How did the T-shirt enter the fashion world? If Marlon Brando seduced women around the world with his sweat-soaked T-shirt in A Streetcar Named Desire, it's James Dean in Rebel Without a Cause, who launched the white T-shirt as a fashion item. Since then, the T-shirt has continuously been modified, and each of its forms, be it torn, oversized, screenprinted or tie-dyed, reflects the evolution of our society. 50 years and tens of billions of copies later, the T-shirt undoubtedly deserves a film which explores its fate with curiosity, humour, and a dose of criticism...

title: T. Rex Autopsy
description: National Geographic is peeling back the skin to go deep inside one of the Earth's most mysterious creatures, combining biology with palaeontology to explore all its guts and glory. T-Rex Autopsy will literally go under the skin of a full-size T-Rex for the first time ever to reveal how the 65-million-year-old beast may have lived. The massive monster will be life- like inside and out, giving scientists the chance to touch it, smell it, scan it, X-ray it and cut it open from head to toe.

Coping with the loss of their brother, old friend and first love, they delay time: while they experience their continuous walk to last only 24 hours, in fact an entire year passes.

title: Daniel T. Gaming
description: A 15 year old Nintendo fan makes fun of cringy people

title: The Good Sh*t
description: For the first time in human history, children are facing shorter lives than their parents. The reason? Obesity - it's a killer epidemic that destroys millions of lives each year. There isn't a single country that's been able to reduce its obesity rates . . . and unfortunately Kiwis are heavier than most. If the trend continues, we'll see nearly half the world's population as clinically overweight or obese in just 12 years time. But what if there was a silver bullet solution? Well, a team of New Zealand scientists may have found one. Amazingly, it's all natural - but the solution is not for the faint hearted, or the weak-stomached. They believe the cure for obesity could lie inside our faeces. Our 'gut bugs' team will take fit people's poo and feed it to obese people to see if it makes them thin. And surprisingly there's a lot to suggest this theory might not be so crazy. Over the next six months, we'll be following four obese teenage girls to see if this revolutionary treatment actually works. The girls won't be dieting, but they will definitely be on trial as we see their successes and struggles. Along the way, we'll also dive into the cutting edge of science behind the human microbiome, how we gain weight, and why fat can be so stubborn to lose. And it's not just about the girls - the reputations of our team of elite researchers are on the line too. If their theory is right, this ground-breaking treatment could change the lives of every obese and overweight person on the planet. There's just a whole lot of crap they'll have to get through first. Welcome to the secretive world of human poo trials.

title: Para sa isa't isa
description: It follows Zion Magtibay and Erin Revina, former high school rivals turned lovers who marry but separate after 10 years. In desperation, Zion makes a wish at a magical well to turn back time - and wakes up a decade earlier, with a second chance to change everything.

title: Giuseppe w Warszawie
description: Adventures of the Italian soldier in a rebellious Warsaw in 1943, between Germans and the Polish resistance.

title: Sla W Slam
description: After her mother's death, Karima, who works as a notary in Casablanca, returns to her hometown, Boujad, to receive her inheritance, driven by her disillusion with love. She finds herself forced to practice her mother's profession as a wedding planner, enlisting the help of her failed childhood friends.

title: Ghasil W Libis
description: The irony of politics and the social reality in Iraq performed in comedic sketches through each episode.

title: W gli sposi
description: W Gli Sposi (Just Married) is a romantic comedy set both in Italy and the United States. The story follows the adventures of Maria, an aristocratic Italian woman who, together with her brother-in-law, travels from Milan to a small rural town in Georgia for her son's wedding. She will find herself in a reality made of people who work the fields and live a simple life. The plot develops through a series of funny situations with the villagers and the future mother-in-law, a strong woman who runs an Italian restaurant. Will love prevail in the end?

title: W Ltaayna
description: Glory and Hala is a love story that takes place in our current era, arising between the son of one of the ministers of corruption Majd, and Princess Hala, the daughter of Prince Omar Kabbara, who was known for his patriotism and his struggle against antiquities dealers, to end up being accused of a corruption case. It was fabricated for him by the mafia because of the files in his possession that incriminate them.

title: W. House
description: Interconnected tales highlighting the ugliness lying at the core of the shiny lights of an urban corporate culture in an Indian Metropolitan. With a mystery at its core, it's a character study of several facades of human nature.

title: Nothing About You Scares Me
description: During the production of the play based on Aristophanes' "Birds" three artist friends need to take responsibility for the roles they play in their social microcosm. In the meantime, an unusual post-hipster melodrama unfolds.

title: W Significa Guerra
description: Beware of Nosfero's army - they worship strength and have no mercy for the weak. His dangerous cult begins a wave of terror through the wasteland. In their way is Sgt. W2 of the special police forces.

title: Fallen Honor - F.L.O.W. Project
description: Fallen Honor - F.L.O.W. Project

title: Anf w Thalath Oyoun
description: A doctor's romantic adventures with 3 women,the ups and downs of love and life changes.

title: Short w Fanelah w Cap
description: Three friends who work in Sharm El-Sheikh, each with their own story. One of them helps the daughter of an Arab minister to escape from her father, who refuses her marriage to the one she loves. Events intertwine after she escaped and discovered the truth about her loved one.

title: Rabiye Kurnaz vs. George W. Bush
description: Desperate to help her son, Rabiye Kurnaz, a housewife and loving mother from Bremen, goes to the police, notifies authorities and almost despairs at their impotence and in the end, against all the odds, something truly remarkable happens.

title: W Ana Ahebak Baad
description: A light comedy that tackles the marital conflicts that arise over time, through the story of the couple, Khaled and Laura, who have many disagreements. With the help of Mona, Laura monitors Khaled all the time, believing that he is cheating on her.

title: W Kol Ma Neftreq
description: The tale of Nour, whose husband Hussam's family decides to get rid of her after she learns their secrets. But as Nour returns to life, she begins to look for her kidnapped daughter and plan revenge on Hussam's family.

title: W/Bob and David
description: Bob and David emerge from the time machine they entered sixteen years ago and are reunited with the cast of Mr. Show.

title: W. What remains of the lie
description: A 50 year-old man -adopted - at the age of five- has no knowledge of his previous history. he thinks that he was born as a Jew in a concentration camp. The people close to Bruno, react with astonishment. In 1998, Bruno meets the Jewish journalist Daniel G, After only 10 minutes, Ganzfried gets that there is something wrong with the story. Today, 17 years after the scandal, Bruno lives a isolated life. The film will nevertheless, or perhaps, describe an aspect of Swiss mentality that refuses to face up to the truth and which suffers under its own insignificance.

title: Drzwi w murze
description: Accomplished playwright supervises the stage rehearsals for his new play away from home. He rents a room at a private house, which is owned by mother and daughter. Wiktor gets entangled in the two women's bizarre relationship.

title: Elliel w akhro
description: The events revolved around (Rahim Al-Manshawi) the self-made Saydi man who falls in love with the singer (Hasanat), and when he offered his marriage to her to his brothers, they refused, so that they maintained their social status, so he decided to deprive them of their father's inheritance, to escalate the events.

title: X & Y
description: YSHA wants to travel to make amends with people she hurt in the past. XANDER is in need of money to support his family. The two accidentally meet---will love find its way through them too?

title: X-Rated
description: A man is asked by his parents to run an apartment complex they own and becomes acquainted with an intriguing hippie girl and various other people from all walks of life who live there.

title: Bunker X09
description: In a world where the air has become poisonous, hope flickers only deep underground. Alexey has turned his life into a never-ending experiment, trying to atone for the deaths of his loved ones. But Anna's arrival changes everything. She brings life, emotion, and... into the cold bunker. While the heroes try to decipher the virus's code, forces outside the bunker are closing in, seeking the cure for themselves. This is a story about trust, betrayal, and the lengths people will go to for a breath of fresh air. Can love overcome the instinct for self-preservation when the timer has already started?

title: X
description: Photographer John Gabriel, in his mid-twenties, coincidentally meets 13 year old Flora, who's run off from home and has nowhere to sleep. They start a love affair due to both of their need for affection.

title: Servant X Service
description: The ward office where Yamagami Lucy has been hired employs many unique characters on its staff. Yamagami and her colleagues are full of energy and secrets as they're hard at work (?!) in this workplace comedy.

title: Y/Our Music
description: Y/OUR MUSIC immerses itself in the world of Thai musical expressions, from traditional music to labor songs and classical pop to urban indie music, spanning different locales and generations. As nine musicians display their musical expression, the rural or urban environments that influenced their sound are also explored. The hands that play traditional instruments amid the red dust clouds, the work songs being hummed in front of grains awaiting harvest, and the indie music born out of concrete basements create a melodious ecosystem. The film creates a sensory journey through some of the sounds and environments that encapsulate the music, from the noisy polluted streets of Bangkok to the calm, arid fields of Isan. While inhabiting different worlds, the musicians are linked by the same passion to bring their artistic aspirations to the fore and survive outside the pop mainstream.

title: Studio Sessions 3
description:
Two weeks ago was the debut episode of CCW: Studio Sessions! It was a wonderful night of action, emotion and passion. It was Trevor Straud's final night in City Championship Wrestling, and he ended up in two matches, the second of which was  a CCW Championship Match against Jay Abrams!

Then the next week on the second episode of Studio Sessions we saw Joseph Antonio Guerrero form a mentorship with Dean Grassi. The Abrams Army defeated the returning Ultra Divine. To cap off the night, Chris Moore defeated CCW Champion, Jay Abrams to capture the championship with the help of none other than long time rival, Jonathan Presley!

On THIS episode, episode 3 of Studio Sessions and it's a big one!

First we will see some clips from Last Week's Studio Sessions.

We get Alex Lynch's thoughts on Jonathan Presley's new relationship with Chris Moore!

Then from there, we'll hear from the new team of Joseph Antonio Guerrero and Dean Grassi.

The new team of Guerrero and Grassi will meet Abrams Army representatives, T'Shuk the Terrible and Ike Watts in a match up that will see the winning team challenge for the CCW Tag Team Championship later on in the same episode!

Speaking of the CCW Tag Team Champions, once the challengers are determined, we will hear from the Champions themselves, Evan Encore and Miles Montagne, Third Degree.

The Mysterious Movado who made his return to CCW following a lengthy absence from the CCW scene just two weeks agon on the debut episode of Studio Sessions. This week, he takes on the Golden Empire's Castro Young alongside, Midas G. King!

Midas G. King leads the "Golden Enforcer" H5 Harrison into battle against the Iraq native, Ali Muhammad. Will Ali Muhammad make a name for himself by defeating the former All Media and Tag Team Champion, H5 Harrison or will The Golden Enforcer make another example out of his opponent?

Paul Bowser makes an announcement concerning the CCW All Media Champion and the All Media Champion himself, Harley Rock!

"The Karate ADULT" Mason Gaida steps into the squared circle with the "Alpha Lykan" Alex Lynch for a singles match with great All Media Championship implications.

Former CCW Tag Team Champions, T'Shuk the Terrible and Ike Watts look to regain those belts when they take on Champions, Evan Encore and Miles Montagne, collectively known as Third Degree in a Tag Team Championship Match up! Are we looking at a successful defense or are we looking at the first ever, Two-Time CCW Tag Team Champions?

In your main event,  It's Chris Moore w/Jonathan Presley vs. King Kong Coleman for the CCW Heavyweight Championship! Will King Kong Coleman finally be able to capture the Heavyweight Championship or will the Maestro conduct another orchestral victory in his first Championship defense!?

description: "4:30" traces the relationship between Xiao Wu, an eleven year old Chinese Boy and his tenant Jung, a thirty-something Korean man. Told entirely from the perspective of the boy, Xiao Wu, this story of two very different characters is less about friendship than about a shared experience and appreciation of solitude. "4:30" starts with Xiao sneaking to the room of Jung in the early hours of the morning, and stealing from the Korean man. Just as getting intoxicated is a habit for Jung, who only staggers back to his rented room when drunk, soon stealing for Xiao Wu becomes equally as compulsive. We soon realize that Jung's true intention for staying in Singapore is suicide. It is only through Xiao's encounter with Jung failing in his bid to die that he begins to understand his true fascination with Jung.

title: Jackstone 5
description: Five gay men who were inseparable in their youth-calling themselves the "Jackstone 5"-reunite decades later after living very different lives. What begins as a lighthearted catch-up filled with nostalgia gradually exposes the wounds, secrets and compromises each carried in order to survive in a conservative society. Some lived abroad, some married, some hid their true selves, and others chased love and failed. As old tensions resurface and buried emotions return, the friends are forced to confront who they were and who they've become. description:
5+5+ takes a personal and good humored look into the universe of contemporary art in Brazil. Taking a 1967 print by artist Carlos Vergara as its starting point, the film captures how this specific work participated in the personal histories of the various people who own it today.

Having inherited a print from the series Five Problems, Five Illustrations (1967), the scriptwriter together with the director of the film, dig up its genealogy, investigate the context in which it was created and the impact its various copies have had on the lives of the people who have had them hanging in their homes through the years. Through touching interviews and abundant never before seen archival footage, the documentary paints a multifaceted picture of Brazilian society and its art scene in the late 1960s in light of the recent military coup and ensuing censorship. Interviewees include artist Carlos Vergara, experimental film director Ivan Cardoso, and a slew of surprising characters who through the most varied circumstances came into contact with this work in their lives.
